text:
Sam: Postmortem (IO cache eviction) is live. We need to convert the remediation list into tests + owners: replay/regression, sustained load, promptset additions, and a chaos drill. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026

Priya: Agreed. I'd like each item to map to a short-lived ticket and a CI job. Can we pick owners now?

Marta: I can own the deterministic replay harness. Plan: implement a trace-replay runner, add a stochastic pressure scenario, and wire a nightly CI job. ETA: 10 business days.

Kai: Infra will extract two representative traces and sanitize them. I'll drop sanitized bundles in s3://incidents/io-eviction/samples and open a small access grant. ETA: 48h.

Taylor: I'll take promptsets + evals. Two promptsets (short/long context) and an eval that reports latency + correctness deltas. Acceptance: P95 <= 1.3x baseline, accuracy drop < 1%. ETA: 7 days.

Priya: I'll own the sustained load orchestration (90m ramp). Creating PERF ticket now and requesting a temporary infra quota bump.

ops-bot: PERF-5200 "eviction-sustained-90m" created and linked to IO-CACHE-2026. CI template `eviction-suite-nightly` available.

Marta: Proposed labels & naming for discoverability:
```
tests/eviction/
  - eviction_replay.yaml
  - eviction_sustained_90m.yaml
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","chaos","nightly"]
```

Sam: Chaos drill plan: tabletop first (30m) then single controlled run in staging. Marta to lead live run, Kai to provision staging eviction signals, Taylor to run evals. I'll schedule the tabletop.

Priya: Dependencies: sanitized traces from Kai, infra quota approval, and a small CI minutes budget. Noted in PERF-5200.

Kai: I'll post scrubbed trace links to the ticket and ping infra-schedule. Scrub job ETA ~48h.

Marta: I'll open PR with harness and include a short README showing how to run locally with sanitized traces. Checklist in PR: 1) harness PR, 2) sanitized traces, 3) CI job, 4) PERF ticket link, 5) acceptance criteria doc.

Taylor: I'll add golden baseline outputs and runner examples to the PR. Also tag promptsets with `eviction/latency` and `eviction/correctness`.

Sam: Owners recap: Marta (harness + live run), Taylor (promptsets + evals), Priya (load orchestration + JIRA), Kai (traces + infra), Sam (tabletop + follow-up).

Priya: Please drop final ETAs into PERF-5200 by EOD so I can lock the drill date.

ops-bot: CI job `eviction-suite-nightly` will run at 03:30 UTC daily once the harness PR merges.

Marta: One more: propose alert rule draft -> if eviction rate > 0.6% for 10m AND P99 tail > 2x baseline, auto-open an ops breadcrumbs ticket. I'll add to alerts RFC.

Sam: Thanks all. I'll convert this thread into the postmortem follow-up doc and link back to PERF-5200 + PRs. We'll reconvene after the tabletop. :thumbsup:
